350c54cafb1d53ef71b1958d7a9af0ecdbbe29ef.sourceText: None表示不增加鲁棒损失，按约束误差的平方处理。HuberLoss、CauchyLoss用于减弱大误差约束的影响；它们不能保证删掉全部错误匹配，也会影响大误差但真实有效的约束。
350c54cafb1d53ef71b1958d7a9af0ecdbbe29ef.translatedText: None means no robust loss is added, and the constraint error is treated as its square\. HuberLoss and CauchyLoss are used to reduce the influence of constraints with large errors; they cannot guarantee the removal of all incorrect matches, and they also affect constraints with large errors that are actually valid\.

35a0f2a49fd524f2ed784dee64bc4a321be17eb5.translatedText: If there is an early return in the middle, or an exception is thrown,`fclose` will not be executed, causing a resource leak\. Similar problems also occur with memory (`malloc/free`), locks (`lock/unlock`), sockets, and all other resources that require "acquire\-release"\.
